In his mind, the question coiled uncomfortably: was this bizarre detour truly the pilgrimage his family had sent him across the Atlantic to make? He had spent his youth in Paris being quietly reminded of his lineage, yet nothing in his mother’s letters had mentioned wandering into an abandoned Nevada sanctuary or breaking into the North Carolina Museum of Natural History.
